content: 2026 AI-MVP stack consensus: FastAPI+Next.js split is the dominant production pattern for streaming LLM apps; Streamlit remains fast for internal demos but absent from 2026 customer-facing MVP stack lists (rerun model fights streaming + multi-step state; DS-demo aesthetic). For judge-facing hackathon demos a single Next.js repo with route handlers doing SSE streaming is the lean single-stack choice.
